newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sankyo seen posting record interim current profit.
newsitem.headline: Sankyo seen posting record interim current profit.

text.p: Sankyo Co Ltd is expected to post parent current profits of about 50 billion yen in the six months to September 30, 1996, up 13 percent from the same period the year before, due to robust sales of its drugs, a Japanese newspaper said on Tuesday.
The expected half-year parent current profit would be the pharmaceutical maker's largest interim profit ever, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun economic daily said.
An increase in sales of its Mevalotin drug especially helped in pushing up the company's half-year profit, the paper said.

The paper also said that Sankyo's full-year parent current profit in 1996/97 would be about 92 billion yen, up six percent from the year before. Sankyo is expected to raise its annual dividend for 1996/97 to 19.8 yen, up 1.2 yen from the year before, the paper said.
A spokesman for Sankyo was not immediately available for comment.
